chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from al-Ala' from one of our companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The wine drinker, if he falls sick, do not visit him; and if he dies, do not attend his funeral; and if he testifies, do not accept his testimony; and if he proposes marriage, do not give him in marriage; and if he asks you for an entrustment, do not entrust it to him.'
ai.seo_question: What are the social and legal rulings for a wine drinker in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the wine drinker as a distinct social category, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential view that habitual consumption constitutes a major sin (kabirah) warranting specific communal sanctions. The five scenarios illustrate a gradual withdrawal of social integration, from withholding visitation during illness to excluding them from marriage and financial trust, thereby preserving the community's moral integrity.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Al A’ala, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The wine drinker, if he were to fall sick, so do not console him, and if he dies, so do not attend it (funeral), and if he were to testify, so do not ratify him, and if he proposes, so do not give in marriage to him, and if he were to ask you for an entrustment, so do not entrust it to him’.
en.sarwar: 5. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from al-‘Ala’ from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. “

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘If a wine drinker becomes ill do not visit him. If he dies do not attend his funeral, if he testifies do not rely his testimony, if he proposes marriage do not marry him and if he asks to trust him about a trust do not trust him.’”
